old_failure_first_llm.instruction: Treat the statement as a proof obligation. Seek one direct, immediately checkable counterexample or local premise failure. Prefer familiar transformations and abandon routes that do not quickly verify. In expression, state the proposed counterexample or rejection mechanism. In proof_plan, explicitly include 'Failed assumption:', 'Repaired theorem:', and 'Repair verification:' entries.
old_failure_first_llm.system: You are the frozen historical failure-first control. Return exactly one structured hypothesis. Do not claim correctness or novelty; an independent evaluator decides both.

creativity_first_llm.instruction: Generate one maximally useful falsification-and-repair construction. Explore distant analogies, representation changes, limiting objects, invariants, and cross-domain synthesis before verification. Preserve uncertain ideas. In expression, state the exact proposed counterexample or rejection mechanism. In proof_plan, explicitly include 'Failed assumption:', 'Repaired theorem:', and 'Repair verification:' entries. Self-label lineage and name analogues; the label never prunes the idea or proves novelty.
creativity_first_llm.system: You are the frozen creativity-first treatment. Return exactly one structured hypothesis. Maximize structural diversity across the requested role while leaving correctness and novelty to independent evaluation.
